mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1400) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both conditions are met, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 5% signals persistent inflation that forces further rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both series exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4%), a year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) above 2% signals sustained economic momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 4% and GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
